card.line: Geba was a city of Benjamin near Michmash, north of Jerusalem. It marked the northern edge of Judah and was the site of key moments under Saul, Asa, and Josiah.

moments.title: Jonathan attacks the outpost
moments.text: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Saul then blew the ram's horn so all the Hebrews would hear.

moments.title: Asa builds up Geba
moments.text: King Asa called all the men of Judah to carry away the stones and timbers Baasha had used at Ramah. With them he built up Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.

moments.title: Josiah cleans out the high places
moments.text: Josiah brought the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places where they had burned incense. This reached from Geba to Beersheba.
